PrivateType is a private, local push-to-talk dictation app for Windows. Hold a shortcut, speak, and release it to insert text into the field where dictation began, without cloud recognition or transcript history.

## Improvements in this release

### Hear when dictation is ready

- A short sound signals that model loading has finished and the microphone is ready. Keep holding the shortcut, then speak after the sound.
- Choose Ping, Chime, Bell, or a custom WAV/MP3 in **Settings → Ready sound**.
- Adjust the volume from 0% (muted) to 100%. The default volume is 80%.
- Use **Preview** to hear the selected sound immediately, without waiting for the model to unload and reload.
- Custom files are copied into app storage when saved. Playback uses at most the first three seconds, and falls back to Ping if a saved custom file becomes unreadable.
- The ready sound plays only for a hold that waited for model loading. Releasing early or failing to start recording does not produce a misleading ready cue.

### Settings and reliability

- All existing settings remain in one window. Content scrolls vertically when needed, with Save and Cancel always accessible.
- Fixed a buffer-copy error that could make Preview and ready sounds silent despite reporting that playback had started.
- Fixed a startup-failure cleanup race.
- Fixed dragging the click-through dictation bubble.

## Download and start

1. Download `PrivateType-1.0.7-win-x64.zip` and `PrivateType-1.0.7-win-x64.zip.sha256` below.
2. Verify the SHA-256 checksum.
3. Extract the complete ZIP into a writable folder.
4. Open `PrivateType 1.0.7` and double-click `PrivateType.exe`.
5. Approve the separate local speech-model download on first launch if the verified model is not already in the shared cache.

The model is not bundled in the ZIP. PrivateType downloads it directly from NVIDIA on Hugging Face and verifies its pinned size and SHA-256 hash before use.

## Requirements

- 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11
- A modern x64 CPU and at least 4 GB RAM; 8 GB or more is recommended
- About 2 GB free disk space for the portable app, model, and working room
- [Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015–2022 (x64)](https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe)

## Privacy

Speech recognition runs locally. PrivateType has no account, cloud-recognition fallback, telemetry, retained audio, or transcript history. Review diagnostic reports before sharing them because application diagnostics can still contain information about your computer environment.
